name: Nusunde MyHeart
source:
Tokyo, 21st century.
City drown in a long recession is shocked by a series special theft crimes. The swiftest of those phantom thieves is red-haired girl Kaito Bunny the Taker. 
Main character is an orphanage boy adopted by Fujinomiya family. His acquaintance with Ryoko girl from this family strangely coincides with the beginning of thefts.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
21世紀的東京。
長期陷於經濟衰退的城市，因接連發生的離奇竊案而騷動不已。在眾多怪盜之中，行動最快的是一名紅髮少女——怪盜Bunny the Taker。
主角本是孤兒院裡的男孩，後來被藤之宮家收養。他與藤之宮家的少女涼子相識，而兩人的邂逅竟與盜竊案開始發生的時間巧合得令人起疑。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-april-2005-sanarara.html]vndbreview[/url]]
